requirements.description: A university student residence needs schools and universities nearby. Education proximity is set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) because the residence's core purpose depends on being close to education.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1 through A4, B and C. Size (850 sqm, 60 beds), location (Turin) and the CDP/PNRR program are not energy requirements and are not included.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the search point, nearest first.
